name: How should I prepare my kitchen before tile installation starts?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my kitchen before tile installation starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your tile installer arrives, clear your kitchen countertops, appliances, and floor areas. Remove items stored on counters or inside low cabinets if framing or baseboards will be adjusted. For floor projects, disconnect and slide out refrigerators, ranges, or dishwashers, and secure pets away from the work zone. It helps to inspect your space beforehand: note any soft spots in your subfloor, wall drywall damage, or uneven transitions to adjoining rooms. Having your selected tile, grout color preferences, and layout pattern decided ahead of time prevents delays once work starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear countertops, remove portable appliances, clear floor pathways, and finalize your tile design and grout color before the crew arrives on site.
